dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast, jagged light-colored perimeters with sharp gradient transitions to darker interiors. Three prominent rings in the mid-dorsal region show well-defined, non-uniform boundary thicknesses.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid light-gray pixel clusters concentrated along the upper dorsal ridge and near the pelvic region. These clusters lack internal gradients and appear as isolated, asymmetrical high-intensity points.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest mid-dorsal annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary series of smaller blobs and rings form a roughly linear sequence extending from the mid-lateral flank toward the posterior region.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive cluster of four interconnected, thin-walled annuli creates a localized honeycomb-like geometric pattern on the mid-lateral section.
